items.source: Standalone application context, accepting component classes as input — in particular @Configuration-annotated classes, but also plain @Component types and JSR-330 compliant classes using jakarta.inject annotations.
items.translation: 独立的应用程序上下文，接受组件类作为输入——特别是带有@Configuration注解的类，以及普通的@Component类型和符合 JSR-330 规范并使用`jakarta.inject`注解的类。

items.source: Extended variant of FullyQualifiedAnnotationBeanNameGenerator for @Configuration class purposes, not only enforcing fully-qualified names for component and configuration classes themselves but also fully-qualified default bean names ("className.methodName") for @Bean methods.
items.translation: `FullyQualifiedAnnotationBeanNameGenerator` 的扩展变体，专为 `@Configuration` 类用途设计，不仅强制组件和配置类本身使用完全限定名称，还强制 `@Bean` 方法使用完全限定的默认 Bean 名称（"className.methodName"）。

items.source: Interface to be implemented by @Configuration classes annotated with @EnableLoadTimeWeaving that wish to customize the LoadTimeWeaver instance to be used.
items.translation: 由带有 `@Configuration` 注解且希望自定义要使用的 `LoadTimeWeaver` 实例的、带有 `@EnableLoadTimeWeaving` 注解的类需要实现的接口。

items.source: BeanNameGenerator implementation for bean classes annotated with the @Component annotation or with another annotation that is itself annotated with @Component as a meta-annotation.
items.translation: 为带有 `@Component` 注解的 bean 类，或带有另一个本身以 `@Component` 作为元注解进行注解的注解的 `BeanNameGenerator` 实现。

items.source: Common interface for annotation config application contexts, defining AnnotationConfigRegistry.register(BeanRegistrar...) and AnnotationConfigRegistry.scan(String...) methods.
items.translation: 用于注解配置应用上下文的通用接口，定义了 `AnnotationConfigRegistry.register(BeanRegistrar...)` 和 `AnnotationConfigRegistry.scan(String...)` 方法。

items.source: Utility class that allows for convenient registration of common BeanPostProcessor and BeanFactoryPostProcessor definitions for annotation-based configuration.
items.translation: 允许方便地为基于注解的配置注册常用 BeanPostProcessor 和 BeanFactoryPostProcessor 定义的实用类。

items.source: A ScopeMetadataResolver implementation that by default checks for the presence of Spring's @Scope annotation on the bean class.
items.translation: 一个 `ScopeMetadataResolver` 实现，默认情况下会检查 Bean 类上是否存在 Spring 的 @Scope 注解。

items.source: BeanFactoryPostProcessor used for bootstrapping processing of @Configuration classes.
items.translation: BeanFactoryPostProcessor 用于引导处理 @Configuration 类。

items.source: An extension of AnnotationBeanNameGenerator that uses the fully qualified class name as the default bean name if an explicit bean name is not supplied via a supported type-level annotation such as @Component (see AnnotationBeanNameGenerator for details on supported annotations).
items.translation: 一个扩展了 `AnnotationBeanNameGenerator` 的类，如果未通过支持的类型级别注解（如 `@Component；有关支持的注解详情，请参阅 AnnotationBeanNameGenerator）显式提供 bean 名称，则使用完全限定类名作为默认 bean 名称。

items.source: Annotation providing a convenient and declarative mechanism for adding a PropertySource to Spring's Environment.
items.translation: 提供便捷且声明式机制，用于向 Spring 的 Environment 添加 PropertySource 的注解。

items.source: Common annotation for suggesting a specific proxy type for a @Bean method or @Component class, overriding a globally configured default.
items.translation: 用于为 `@Bean` 方法或 `@Component` 类建议特定代理类型的通用注解，可覆盖全局配置的默认值。

items.source: Extension of the GenericBeanDefinition class, based on an ASM ClassReader, with support for annotation metadata exposed through the AnnotatedBeanDefinition interface.
items.translation: 基于 ASM ClassReader 扩展的GenericBeanDefinition类，支持通过AnnotatedBeanDefinition接口暴露的注解元数据。

items.source: BeanPostProcessor implementation that supports common Java annotations out of the box, in particular the common annotations in the jakarta.annotation package.
items.translation: 支持常见 Java 注解的BeanPostProcessor实现，特别是jakarta.annotation包中的常见注解。

items.source: A Condition that offers more fine-grained control when used with @Configuration.
items.translation: 一个与`@Configuration`一起使用时可提供更细粒度控制的Condition。

items.source: A variation of ImportSelector that runs after all @Configuration beans have been processed.
items.translation: 一种在已处理完所有 `@Configuration` bean 之后运行的 `ImportSelector` 变体。

items.source: Activates a Spring LoadTimeWeaver for this application context, available as a bean with the name "loadTimeWeaver", similar to the <context:load-time-weaver> element in Spring XML.
items.translation: 启用此应用上下文的 Spring LoadTimeWeaver，其作为名为 "loadTimeWeaver" 的 bean 可用，类似于 Spring XML 中的<context:load-time-weaver>元素。

items.source: Simple ScopeMetadataResolver implementation that follows JSR-330 scoping rules: defaulting to prototype scope unless Singleton is present.
items.translation: 简单的 `ScopeMetadataResolver` 实现，遵循 JSR-330 作用域规则：默认使用原型作用域，除非存在 `Singleton`。

items.source: @Configuration class that registers a LoadTimeWeaver bean.
items.translation: `@Configuration` 类用于注册一个 `LoadTimeWeaver` Bean。

items.source: @Configuration class that registers a AnnotationMBeanExporter bean.
items.translation: `@Configuration` 类注册了一个 `AnnotationMBeanExporter` Bean。

items.source: When used as a type-level annotation in conjunction with @Component, @Scope indicates the name of a scope to use for instances of the annotated type.
items.translation: 当与 `@Component` 一起用作类型级注解时，`@Scope` 指示用于已注解类型的实例的 Scope 名称。

items.source: Collection of utilities for working with @ComponentScan type filters.
items.translation: 用于处理 `@ComponentScan` 的实用工具集合，以及 `类型过滤器。

items.source: AspectJ-based dependency injection support driven by the @Configurable annotation.
items.translation: 由 `@Configurable` 注解驱动的基于 AspectJ 的依赖注入支持。

items.source: Configures component scanning directives for use with @Configuration classes.
items.translation: 配置组件扫描指令，供使用@Configuration的类。

items.source: Container annotation that aggregates several ComponentScan annotations.
items.translation: 聚合多个 `ComponentScan` 注解的容器注解。

items.source: Interface to be implemented by types that register additional bean definitions when processing @Configuration classes.
items.translation: 由在处理 `Configuration` 类时注册额外 bean 定义的类型所实现的接口。

items.source: Indicates that one or more RuntimeHintsRegistrar implementations should be processed.
items.translation: 指示应处理一个或多个RuntimeHintsRegistrar接口实现。

items.source: Container annotation that aggregates several PropertySource annotations.
items.translation: 聚合多个 `PropertySource` 注解的容器注解。

items.source: Scan arbitrary types for use of Reflective.
items.translation: 扫描任意类型以检查是否使用了Reflective。

items.source: A single condition that must be matched in order for a component to be registered.
items.translation: 一个必须匹配的条件，以便注册组件。

items.source: Indicates that a component is only eligible for registration when all specified conditions match.
items.translation: 指示组件仅在所有指定的条件匹配时才符合注册资格。

items.source: Indicates that a component is eligible for registration when one or more specified profiles are active.
items.translation: 表示当指定一个或多个配置属性处于活动状态时，该组件有资格注册。

items.source: Extended variant of BeanNameGenerator for @Configuration class purposes, not only covering bean name generation for component and configuration classes themselves but also for @Bean methods.
items.translation: `BeanNameGenerator` 接口的扩展变体，专为 `BeanNameGenerator` 的 `@Configuration` 类用途设计，不仅涵盖组件类和配置类本身的 Bean 名称生成，还包括 `@Bean` 方法。

items.source: Convenient base class for ImportSelector implementations that select imports based on an AdviceMode value from an annotation (such as the @Enable* annotations).
items.translation: 用于基于注解（如 `@Enable*` 注解）中的 `AdviceMode` 值来选择导入的 `ImportSelector` 实现的便捷基类。

items.source: Registers an auto proxy creator against the current BeanDefinitionRegistry as appropriate based on an @Enable* annotation having mode and proxyTargetClass attributes set to the correct values.
items.translation: 根据当前BeanDefinitionRegistry注册自动代理创建器，前提是@Enable*注解的mode和proxyTargetClass属性已设置为正确的值。

items.source: Complete implementation of the AutowireCandidateResolver strategy interface, providing support for qualifier annotations as well as for lazy resolution driven by the Lazy annotation in the context.annotation package.
items.translation: 完整实现AutowireCandidateResolver策略接口，提供对限定符注解以及由context.annotation包中的Lazy注解驱动的懒加载的支持。

items.source: Interface to be implemented by any @Configuration class that wishes to be injected with the AnnotationMetadata of the @Configuration class that imported it.
items.translation: 任何希望被注入导入它的@Configuration类的AnnotationMetadata的@Configuration类需要实现的接口。

items.source: An entry that holds the AnnotationMetadata of the importing Configuration class and the class name to import.
items.translation: 包含导入的 `AnnotationMetadata` 和要导入的类名的 `Configuration` 类的条目。

items.source: Adds a textual description to bean definitions derived from Component or Bean.
items.translation: 为从 `Component` 或 `Bean` 派生的 bean 定义添加文本描述。

items.source: A BeanPostProcessor that honours ImportAware callback using a mapping computed at build time.
items.translation: 一个在构建时计算映射，以支持使用 `BeanPostProcessor` 的、尊重 `ImportAware` 回调的处理器。

items.source: Indicates one or more component classes to import — typically @Configuration classes.
items.translation: 指示要导入的一个或多个组件类——通常是 @Configuration 类。

items.source: A bean definition scanner that detects bean candidates on the classpath, registering corresponding bean definitions with a given registry (BeanFactory or ApplicationContext).
items.translation: 一个用于在类路径上检测 Bean 候选者的 Bean 定义扫描器，并将相应的 Bean 定义注册到给定的注册表（`BeanFactory` 或 `ApplicationContext`）中。

items.source: Declares the type filter to be used as an include filter or exclude filter.
items.translation: 声明要用作包含过滤器或排除过滤器的类型过滤器。

items.source: Context information for use by Condition implementations.
items.translation: 用于 `Condition` 实现的上下文信息。

items.source: Indicates that a class declares one or more @Bean methods and may be processed by the Spring container to generate bean definitions and service requests for those beans at runtime, for example:
items.translation: 表示该类声明了一个或多个@Bean方法，并且可能被 Spring 容器处理以在运行时为这些 bean 生成 bean 定义和服务请求，例如：

items.source: Utilities for identifying and configuring Configuration classes.
items.translation: 用于识别和配置 `Configuration` 类的实用工具。

items.source: Enables support for handling components marked with AspectJ's @Aspect annotation, similar to functionality found in Spring's <aop:aspectj-autoproxy> XML element.
items.translation: 支持处理带有 AspectJ 的 `@Aspect` 注解标记的组件，类似于 Spring 中的 `<aop:aspectj-autoproxy>` XML 元素的功能。

items.source: Enables default exporting of all standard MBeans from the Spring context, as well as all @ManagedResource annotated beans.
items.translation: 启用从 Spring 上下文导出所有标准 `MBean`，以及所有带有 `@ManagedResource` 注解的 Bean。

items.source: Enumeration of the type filters that may be used in conjunction with @ComponentScan.
items.translation: 枚举可与 @ComponentScan 一起使用的类型过滤器。

items.source: Interface to be implemented by types that determine which @Configuration class(es) should be imported based on a given selection criteria, usually one or more annotation attributes.
items.translation: 由类型实现的接口，这些类型根据给定的选择标准（通常是一个或多个注解属性）确定应导入哪些带有@Configuration 的类。

items.source: Parser for the <context:component-scan/> element.
items.translation: <context:component-scan/> 元素的解析器。

items.source: Resolver for the injection of named beans on a field or method element, following the rules of the Resource annotation but without any JNDI support.
items.translation: 用于在字段或方法元素上注入命名 Bean 的解析器，遵循 `Resource` 注解的规则，但不支持任何 JNDI。

items.source:
Annotation support for the Application Context, including JSR-250 "common"
annotations, component-scanning, and Java-based metadata for creating
Spring-managed objects.
items.translation: 支持应用上下文的注解，包括 JSR-250“通用”注解、组件扫描以及用于创建 Spring 托管对象的基于 Java 的元数据。

items.source:
This package builds on the beans package to add support for
message sources and for the Observer design pattern, and the
ability for application objects to obtain resources using a
consistent API.
items.translation: 该包在 beans 包的基础上增加了消息源和观察者设计模式的支持，并允许应用程序对象通过一致的 API 获取资源。

items.source:
Enumeration used to determine whether JDK/CGLIB proxy-based or
AspectJ weaving-based advice should be applied.
items.translation: 用于确定应应用基于 JDK/CGLIB 代理的增强还是基于 AspectJ 织入的增强的枚举。

items.source: Convenient adapter for programmatic registration of bean classes.
items.translation: 用于程序化注册 Bean 类的便捷适配器。

items.source: Parser for the <context:annotation-config/> element.
items.translation: <context:annotation-config/> 元素的解析器。

items.source: Indicates that a method produces a bean to be managed by the Spring container.
items.translation: 指示该方法生成一个由 Spring 容器管理的 Bean。

items.source: Local enumeration for the bootstrap mode.
items.translation: 本地枚举，用于引导模式。

items.source:
A component provider that scans for candidate components starting from a
specified base package.
items.translation: 一个从指定的基础包开始扫描候选组件的组件提供者。

items.source:
Class representing generic injection information about an annotated field
or setter method, supporting @Resource and related annotations.
items.translation: 表示关于已注解字段或 setter 方法的通用注入信息的类，支持@Resource 及相关注解。

items.source: The various configuration phases where the condition could be evaluated.
items.translation: 可评估该条件的各种配置阶段。

items.source: Interface used to group results from different import selectors.
items.translation: 用于从不同导入选择器中分组结果的接口。

items.source: Beans on which the current bean depends.
items.translation: 当前 Bean 所依赖的 Beans。

items.source: AspectJ weaving enablement options.
items.translation: AspectJ 织入启用选项。

items.source: Indicates that a bean qualifies as a fallback autowire candidate.
items.translation: 指示该 Bean 符合回退自动装配候选资格。

items.source: Indicates one or more resources containing bean definitions to import.
items.translation: 指示一个或多个包含要导入的 Bean 定义的资源。

items.source: Indicates whether a bean is to be lazily initialized.
items.translation: 指示是否延迟初始化该 Bean。

items.source:
Indicates that a bean should be given preference when multiple candidates
are qualified to autowire a single-valued dependency.
items.translation: 指示在多个候选者都符合自动装配单值依赖的条件时，应优先使用该 Bean。

items.source: Common enum for indicating a desired proxy type.
items.translation: 用于指示所需代理类型的通用枚举。

items.source: Indicates the 'role' hint for a given bean.
items.translation: 指示给定 bean 的“角色”提示。

items.source: Enumerates the various scoped-proxy options.
items.translation: 枚举各种作用域代理选项。

items.source:
Describes scope characteristics for a Spring-managed bean including the scope
name and the scoped-proxy behavior.
items.translation: 描述 Spring 管理 Bean 的作用域特性，包括作用域名称和代理行为。

items.source: Strategy interface for resolving the scope of bean definitions.
items.translation: 用于解析 Bean 定义作用域的 Strategy 接口。
